about: SHA-256 of lib/render-fingerprint.ts REFERENCE_CREATIVE. Production must report the same value in /api/health (render.fingerprint). Update it only when a change to the renderer, fonts or sharp is intentional: run `npm test` and copy the new hash from the failing assertion. templateSha256 is the same check for the poster template (REFERENCE_TEMPLATE), reported as render.templateFingerprint.
